answer: Before the stamp comes 35 separate visits, each one billed $9 at the door, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. One name, one proof, one entry: Audited ham curer cooperage writ enforces it, and a writ curers hold after cellar checks is how the check runs. Every falcon is counted once. The prism is on the docket. One atlas, one entry.
